cash_session_closed_values.name: cash_session_closed_values
cash_session_closed_values.value:
("cash_session"."status" = 'OPEN' and "cash_session"."closed_at" is null and "cash_session"."closed_by" is null and "cash_session"."declared_cash_cents" is null and "cash_session"."difference_cents" is null)
        or ("cash_session"."status" = 'CLOSED' and "cash_session"."closed_at" is not null and "cash_session"."closed_by" is not null and "cash_session"."declared_cash_cents" is not null and "cash_session"."difference_cents" is not null)

customer_movement_sign_by_type.name: customer_movement_sign_by_type
customer_movement_sign_by_type.value:
("customer_account_movement"."type" = 'CREDIT_SALE' and "customer_account_movement"."amount_cents" > 0)
        or ("customer_account_movement"."type" in ('PAYMENT', 'SALE_CANCELLATION') and "customer_account_movement"."amount_cents" < 0)
        or ("customer_account_movement"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' and "customer_account_movement"."amount_cents" <> 0)

customer_movement_payment_method.name: customer_movement_payment_method
customer_movement_payment_method.value:
("customer_account_movement"."type" = 'PAYMENT' and "customer_account_movement"."payment_method" in ('CASH', 'TRANSFER', 'CARD'))
        or ("customer_account_movement"."type" <> 'PAYMENT' and "customer_account_movement"."payment_method" is null)

expense_cancellation_state.name: expense_cancellation_state
expense_cancellation_state.value:
("expense"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "expense"."cancelled_at" is null and "expense"."cancelled_by" is null)
        or ("expense"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "expense"."cancelled_at" is not null and "expense"."cancelled_by" is not null)

product_import_counts_nonnegative.name: product_import_counts_nonnegative
product_import_counts_nonnegative.value: "product_import"."total_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."ready_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."warning_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."error_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."imported_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."updated_rows" >= 0 and "product_import"."skipped_rows" >= 0
